description:
This is an original BG created by me. There are 3 screenshots of the BG. You can view them above. Included 2 templates. They are required, in order to make a different castle/horror BG.
Give credit, if used. No readme needed, as it's easy to assemble.

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)
